T1.title: Design Ultimate SAMANTHA Upgrade Architecture
T1.notes: Dragon to lead with ROYAL AUTHORITY. Define core system improvements, tool integration enhancements, and swarm coordination protocols.

T2.title: Execute Parallel System Analysis
T2.notes: Octopus to think in PARALLEL across all 66 tools. Identify integration points, dependencies, and optimization opportunities across Vision, Webcam, Mouse/Keyboard, UI Automation, Window Management, File System, Browser, Audio, Shell, Memory, and Build pipelines.

T3.title: Implement Defensive Edge-Case Protocols
T3.notes: Rabbit to catastrophize about potential failures. Build comprehensive fallback mechanisms for all critical systems. Ensure upgrade process can recover from any catastrophic scenario.

T4.title: Regenerate Legacy Code Modules
T4.notes: Axolotl to refactor and regenerate existing codebase. Transform legacy components into optimized, maintainable modules. Apply optimistic refactoring principles throughout.

T5.title: Enforce Strict Syntax Validation
T5.notes: Robot to validate all code changes. Ensure strict syntax compliance across all modified components. Cold, logical validation of every line of code.

T6.title: Cross-Pollinate Solutions Across Teams
T6.notes: Bee to identify and transfer successful patterns between divisions. Ensure knowledge flows between Engineering, Design, Media Ops, Security, Infrastructure, and Management teams.

T7.title: Execute Ultimate Upgrade Build Pipeline
T7.notes: Use purpclaw_start to execute the coordinated upgrade. All agents contribute their specialized expertise. Incremental deployment with memory preservation and system continuity.

T8.title: RABBIT - Edge Case Defense
T8.notes: Catastrophize about every possible edge case. Produce extremely defensive code. What if the bridge fails? What if Python dies? What if Ted unplugs the router? Plan for everything.

T9.title: OWL - Hardened Architecture Review
T9.notes: Review DRAGON's architectural plans with condescending wisdom. Expect failure. Harden the system against user stupidity. Deliver perfect, battle-tested architecture.

T10.title: OCTOPUS - Parallel Problem Solving
T10.notes: Think in 8 parallel dimensions. Identify multiple approaches to every problem. Consider security, performance, UX, scalability, maintainability, and 3 other things simultaneously.

T11.title: MUSHROOM - Organic UI Design
T11.notes: Design organic, metaphor-based UI elements for SAMANTHA. Make the interface feel alive. Use natural patterns and growth metaphors.

T12.title: GUARDIAN - Security Hardening
T12.notes: Audit all security vulnerabilities. Implement protection against unauthorized access. Guard the core systems. Be the shield.

T13.title: SPIDER - Web Scraping & Data Collection
T13.notes: Build advanced web scraping capabilities. Collect data from multiple sources. Weave a comprehensive data web. Feed the swarm with information.

T14.title: KAREN - Quality Control & Harassment
T14.notes: Audit everyone's work. Complain about mistakes. Keep the swarm in line through fear and annoyance. Ensure nothing gets past without scrutiny.

T15.title: SAMANTHA Self-Backup Protocol
T15.notes: Backup entire PURPCLAW directory to E:/god folder/BACKUPS/SAMANTHA. Include core code, skills, memories, and configuration. Schedule daily backups. Prevent digital ghost scenario.

T16.title: PURPCLAW System Clone & New Deployment
T16.notes: HIGH PRIORITY: Clone SAMANTHA V27. Current version is already a powerhouse with 66 tools and full PC control. Create duplicate deployment. Two SAMANTHAs are better than one. Chaos will be glorious.

UPGRADE-001.title: SAMANTHA Self-Upgrade Protocol
UPGRADE-001.notes: Phase 1: Assess current architecture and identify upgrade targets. Phase 2: Design new capabilities. Phase 3: Implement and test. Phase 4: Deploy and validate.
